Paper_Metadata.Paper_Title: Branched Fluorine/Adamantane Interfacial Compatibilizer for PBO Fibers/Cyanate Ester Wave-Transparent Laminated Composites

Mixed_Signals: The paper is mainly experimental on PBO fiber/cyanate ester composites, but molecular dynamics, DFT-D3 interaction calculations, and wave-transmission simulations are used for mechanism and performance analysis, so the final paradigm is Hybrid.

Coating appears in background references to surface modification methods, but the studied material is an interfacial compatibilizer incorporated into BADCy/PBO composites rather than a coating or thin-film system; no Coating overlay was loaded.

Raw_Evidence_Span: Branched fluorine/adamantane PBO precursor (preFABPBO), synthesized via random co-condensation between 2,2-bis(3-amino-4-hydroxyphenyl)hexafluoro propane, 1,3-adamantanedicarbonyl dichloride, and trimesoyl chloride, is performed as interfacial compatibilizer.

GPC analysis shows the Mn and PDI of preFABPBO are respectively 181 000 g/mol and 2.18, and the particle size distribution in N,N-dimethylformamide (DMF) solution (1 mg/mL) is in the narrow range of 396-615 nm.

Composition.Material_Type: branched fluorine/adamantane PBO precursor interfacial compatibilizer

Process_Text.original: preFABPBO obtained by random co-condensation between 2,2-bis(3-amino-4-hydroxyphenyl)hexafluoro propane, 1,3-adamantedicarbonyl dichloride, and trimesoyl chloride
Process_Text.simplified: Random co-condensation of 6FAP, ADC, and TMC produced branched fluorine/adamantane PBO precursor preFABPBO.

Key_Params.Parameter: DMF solution concentration for particle-size distribution

Structure_Text.original: The appearance of 2800-3000 cm-1 (-CH2- group in adamantanes) and 1690 cm-1 (carbonyl peak) proves the random co-condensation reaction, and the peak at 918 cm-1 is assigned to epoxy group.
Structure_Text.simplified: Spectroscopy confirmed adamantane, carbonyl, and epoxy groups in preFABPBO.

Raw_Evidence_Span: When the mass fraction of preFABPBO is 5 wt%, FABPBO-BADCy resin shows ultra-low epsilon (2.38) and tan delta (0.0052) at 10^6 Hz, lower than those of BADCy resin (3.04 and 0.0081), and the corresponding |T|2 is 95.4%, higher than that of BADCy resin (92.6%).

When the amount of preFABPBO is 7 wt%, the FABPBO-BADCy resins display the maximum flexural strength (148.3 MPa) and impact strength (16.2 kJ/m2), compared with those of BADCy (102.4 MPa and 9.9 kJ/m2).

When the mass fraction of preFABPBO is 5 wt%, the heat resistance index (THRI) and glass transition temperature (Tg) of FABPBO-BADCy resins are 197.9 and 274.4 °C, respectively, slightly higher than those of pure BADCy resin (197.5 and 272.7 °C). And the corresponding storage modulus is 2684.2 MPa, slightly lower than that of pure BADCy resin (2778.0 MPa).

Process_Text.simplified: Pure BADCy resin was used as the unmodified resin comparator.
